title: USVetHub verified benefit records
notes: Reads hand-written records from data/curated/benefits/*.json. Touches no network.
This is the layer a person edits. Some state benefit rules will never scrape cleanly, and a hand-checked record beats a confidently wrong scraped one on the pages that get the most traffic.
Records here are marked confidence: verified, which means a human read the official page. Do not mark anything verified that you have not actually read.

humanCurated lets records from this source carry a checkedAt date through the worker. Every other source has checkedAt stripped, so no scraper can ever claim a person read a page. Only scripts/verify.mjs should write checkedAt.
Guards are relaxed on purpose: a human deleting a record is an intentional edit, not a scraper breaking.
